summary: Frontend-only regression on the loading-spinner fix. All 4 requested scenarios PASS: (1) Fresh load without token reaches login instantly with 'Welcome to Gk Gifts' heading visible. (2) Stale/bogus token reload lands on login within ~1s (backend returned 401 on /auth/me, catch cleared token). (3) Stall fallback UI ('Taking longer than usual…' + testID='app-loading-retry') appears at ~6.3s when /api/auth/me is deliberately hung via Playwright route, and clicking 'Continue to sign in' navigates to /(auth)/login. (4) Happy-path login with demo@gkgifts.com / Demo@123 succeeds; reload with a real valid token reaches Home immediately with no stall UI. The user-reported infinite-spinner bug is resolved.

Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents.' — appears on every render, likely from a library or wrapper component.

action_items: (Optional / low-priority) Migrate remaining `shadow*` style props to `boxShadow` and `pointerEvents` prop to `style.pointerEvents` to silence RN-web deprecation warnings. Not user-facing, does not affect this iteration's fix.
TOKEN_KEY is still the legacy string 'aura_token' (comment in api.ts already notes this). Consider renaming to 'gk_token' in a future iteration for brand consistency — no functional impact.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts: AbortController + 15s timeout is correctly implemented and the AbortError is translated to a friendly message. Good.
app/index.tsx: 6s stall timer + escape-hatch button is clean and does not leak the timer (cleanup on unmount). Verified working.
auth.tsx refresh(): try/catch correctly clears the token on any /auth/me failure (401, timeout, or network abort), which is what unblocks the fresh-load and stale-token scenarios.
seed_data_creation: None. Used existing seeded demo@gkgifts.com / Demo@123 account.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Loading-spinner bug is fully resolved. TOKEN_KEY in localStorage is 'aura_token'. Stall fallback timer is 6s and testID is 'app-loading-retry'. To reproduce stall scenario in Playwright, use page.route on '**/api/auth/me' with an async handler that sleeps (route.abort makes fetch fail immediately and does NOT trigger the stall).
rca_of_issue: Original bug: /index only rendered a bare <ActivityIndicator/> with no timeout on the api() fetch. If /auth/me hung (bad network, proxy stall, etc.), loading stayed true forever and the user saw a permanent spinner. Fix (verified working): (a) api.ts wraps fetch in AbortController with a 15s timeout that rejects with a friendly error, letting refresh() catch → clear token → set loading=false → Gate redirects to login. (b) app/index.tsx now shows the brand logo + a 6s stall detector that reveals a 'Continue to sign in' escape button, so even during the 6-15s window before the timeout fires the user has a manual way out. Both mechanisms verified end-to-end.
